other_conditions: The applicant must be studying in a government or aided private college.
For Ph.D. applicants, at least 55% marks in post‑graduation are required.
For postgraduate applicants, at least 55% marks in graduation are required.
For graduation merit‑cum‑means scholarships, at least 55% marks in the examination of the Board of Secondary Education are required.
For graduation qualification‑cum‑means scholarships, at least 60% marks in the graduation qualifying examination of the Board of Secondary Education are required.
Sports applicants must be a member of the national sports team in the school team of Madhya Pradesh, or a member of the adult state team, or have placed in the top three at a state‑level competition.
benefits_summary: Scholarships are awarded for up to 10 months, ranging from ₹300 to ₹600 per month depending on the program (PhD ₹600, M.Phil. ₹500, Postgraduate ₹500, Graduation ₹300, Sports ₹300).
